title: iHeartRadio Celebrates Olivia Rodrigo’s Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival with Two National On Air Specials Featuring Exclusive Music From the Festival
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*“iHeartRadio's She Is The Voice with Special Guest Olivia Rodrigo,” a one-hour program with Olivia as guest host, airing music from artists performing at Daisy Chain Fields Festival broadcasting iHeartRadio ALT stations on Friday, August 28*


*“iHeartRadio Presents: Olivia Rodrigo: Songs from Daisy Chain Fields,” featuring exclusive live performances from her new album you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love broadcasting on iHeartRadio CHR and Hot AC stations August 31*


NEW YORK- August 25, 2026- iHeartRadio is hosting two exclusive national radio specials with Olivia Rodrigo that features music and performances from Daisy Chain Fields, Olivia special guest hosting, exclusive interviews and live performances from her new album, *you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love,* available now via Geffen Records.


On Friday, August 28 at 9 p.m. ET iHeartRadio will broadcast **“iHeartRadio's She Is The Voice with Special Guest Olivia Rodrigo,”** a special nationwide edition of the weekly specialty show that typically airs on iHeartRadio Los Angeles’ ALT 98.7, will air on iHeartRadio ALT stations nationwide. Hosted by Lisa Worden, Program Director for ALT 98.7 and Senior Vice President of Rock and Alternative for iHeartMedia, the one-hour special will feature Olivia Rodrigo as guest host and will spotlight artists performing at Daisy Chain Fields, celebrating women shaping music today. iHeartRadio's She Is The Voice with Special Guest Olivia Rodrigo will also be available on iHeartRadio digital stations Alt Radio and She Rocks Radio and replay nightly at 7 p.m. ET on She Rocks Radio from August 28 through September 4.


On Monday, August 31 at 7 p.m. local time iHeartRadio will broadcast **“iHeartRadio Presents: Olivia Rodrigo: Songs from Daisy Chain Fields,”** featuring exclusive live performances from her new album *you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love* . The exclusive 30-minute special with Olivia Rodrigo features live performances recorded during her Daisy Chain Fields festival set, including her single "drop dead." The special will air on CHR and Hot AC stations on August 31 at 7 p.m. local time and on iHeartRadio’s digital station Hit Nation at 7 p.m. ET.


Live performances from Daisy Chain Fields are furnished by Geffen Records.
